season: September 1 inclusive to October 1 exclusive, same window each year
boundary_status: Same analyst-defined window as the baseline; not an official city boundary
grid_note: Fixed 10 m grid aligned to the original thermal-grid origin; original thermal analysis is untouched
composite: Mean of the nine scene probability bands, then argmax; ties choose the first class
resampling: Nearest-neighbour to the fixed grid; no implicit bilinear class resampling
threshold_note: Provisional prespecified screening choices; not calibrated accuracy or automatic publication approval
unknown_rule: No observation, fewer than three valid observations, or composite confidence below the threshold; never counted as bare or zero greenery
change_support: Intersection of accepted pixels on both years at each threshold
manual_review_status: pending; no historical reference labels supplied
integration_with_priority: None; original WorldCover eligibility, NDVI, temperature, rankings and seven CSVs are preserved
licence: CC BY 4.0; Dynamic World attribution required if data are retrieved
team_model: None; Dynamic World is an upstream AI product; SamGeo and additional models deferred
